title: Micron Stock (MU) Falls 1.1% as Market Slips After Hot CPI (Nov 10)
summary: Micron (MU) fell 1.10% to $725.11 on Nov 10 after hotter October CPI data, as a filing named Micron a $1 billion buyer in Anthropic's placement.
body_markdown:
## Why Micron Stock Fell


The main event landed before the open. According to the[U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/cpi.nr0.htm) , the[Consumer Price Index](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/global-markets-brace-for-us-cpi-futures-up-china-trade-surplus-japan-bonds-boj-etf-sales/) rose 0.4% in October on a seasonally adjusted basis and the index excluding food and energy rose 0.3%, in a release published at 8:30 a.m. ET on November 10. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-technology-stocks-slip-1-174919039.html) , forecasts had called for gains of 0.3% and 0.2%, Micron traded about 3% lower before the open, and traders priced roughly 84% odds of a quarter-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December.


The same morning, Anthropic's amended S-1 registration statement confirmed Micron as a $1.0 billion buyer in its private placement, according to GuruFocus, covering about 13.5 million Class N shares at the $74 midpoint. GuruFocus described the commitment as "a signal rather than a driver" for a company of Micron's size.


The session also followed a volatile week. Per[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-valuation-insane-good-way-184529620.html) , Micron fell 17.5% on Thursday, November 5, as the Democrats' midterm sweep stoked fears of limits on new data centers, then rebounded 5.1% the next day.


## MU Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Revenue rose to $133.2 billion in fiscal 2026 from $37.4 billion, with higher prices doing nearly all the work, and free cash flow reached a record $59.0 billion, according to TIKR.
- Management guided its fiscal first quarter to about 86.25% non-GAAP gross margin and called that level the floor for fiscal 2027, per TIKR.
- TIKR reported that over 75% of Micron's 2027 output is already committed, while its new capacity arrives only from mid-2027.


### Risks


- Rates: GuruFocus tied the December rate-hike odds to the hotter October data and added that rate risk "may matter less than memory pricing," which it said the next[quarterly earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) will test.
- Data center policy: TIKR cited UBS estimates that construction pauses could threaten about 30% of the US capacity additions expected in 2028.
- Margins: TIKR cited consensus estimates for gross margin to slide from 87.0% in fiscal 2027 to 65.5% by fiscal 2030 as new supply arrives.


Next on the calendar is Micron's fiscal first-quarter report, which TIKR expects in mid-to-late December (an estimate, not a confirmed date).
